fields.label: Entity
fields.description: The legal entity. Same string the warehouse uses for data_area_id, so the ClickHouse join is unaffected.

fields.label: Main Account
fields.description: Equity account to apply historical rate to. Main Account is named by its own code, so the stored value is the bare account code the warehouse joins on.

fields.label: Rate Date
fields.description: Date at which equity was acquired/established

fields.label: From Currency
fields.description: The entity's functional currency (Entity → Functional Currency). Shown, never stored.

fields.label: To Currency
fields.description: The group's reporting currency (the Consolidation Group root → Reporting Currency). Shown, never stored.

fields.label: Rate (1 From = rate To)
fields.description: Units of the To currency for one unit of the From currency at the rate date, the same direction as the group's closing and average rates: the warehouse multiplies the entity's amount on this account by it.
